# clavis env similar

<p class="cli-lead">Compare every pair of environments and show how alike they are</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis env similar
```

</div>

Compare every pair of environments and show how alike they are: the
share of keys they have in common, and how many of those hold an
identical value. Two environments that are mostly identical may be
copies that should differ, for example a staging that still points at
production's credentials. Values are fetched (the read is audited) and
compared on your computer; they are never printed.

## Examples

```sh
clavis env similar
clavis env similar --json
```
